welcome.title: Welcome to Cloudhub
welcome.no_telegraf_msg: Cloudhub requires an agent to collect metrics. Telegraf is currently not installed.
welcome.no_hosts_msg: Telegraf is installed, but no hosts are detected. This usually occurs when the agent fails to connect to the database.
welcome.no_dashboards_msg: No dashboards are currently configured to view your metrics.
welcome.instruction_agent_admin: Navigate to <1>Agent Admin</1> or <3>Manage Sources</3> to install and configure Minions.
welcome.instruction_ensure_telegraf: Ensure <1>Telegraf</1> is installed on your host machines.
welcome.instruction_telegraf_config: Check your <1>Telegraf configuration</1> to ensure the output plugin is pointing to the correct database instance.
welcome.instruction_verify_auth: Verify the authentication credentials in the Telegraf config.
welcome.instruction_once_connected: Once the database connection is established and metrics are arriving, your hosts will appear.
welcome.instruction_navigate_dashboard: Navigate to the <1>Dashboards</1> page to create your first dashboard and start visualizing your data.

hosts.alert_status_disabled: Kapacitor alarm settings are required to show the server status.
hosts.no_ip_msg: Not displayed because connect-agent is not installed.
hosts.failed_to_load: Failed to load data or responding too slowly.

server_alert.title: Server Alert Management
server_alert.delete_failed: Failed to delete alert group rule.

alert_group_rule.pause_desc1: Sends repeated notifications at the set interval while the event persists.
alert_group_rule.pause_tooltip: Ex: If set to 1 hour, alerts will continue to trigger every hour until the issue is resolved.
alert_group_rule.recovery_desc1: Sends notifications only when the state changes, such as when an event occurs or is resolved.
alert_group_rule.recovery_tooltip: Ex: If enabled, an alert will trigger once when the issue occurs, and once when it is resolved.
alert_group_rule.placeholder: Enter rule name (e.g. CPU threshold exceeded)
alert_group_rule.target_server_helper: Alerts will only occur on the selected servers among hosts reporting from the current source.
alert_group_rule.disabled_reason_telegraf: Telegraf '{{measurement}}' data collection is required to use this alert.

alert_group_basic.all_groups_will_receive: All groups will receive this alert.
alert_group_basic.selected_groups_will_receive: Selected groups will receive this alert.
alert_group_basic.test_receipt_hint: Send a test notification to the currently configured targets.
alert_group_basic.no_selected_groups_or_members: No groups selected or no members to receive.
alert_group_basic.email_body_placeholder: Enter the body for your email here. Can contain HTML
alert_group_basic.graph_placeholder: Select a time series to display the graph in this area.
alert_group_basic.no_data_in_range: No data in the selected time range.
alert_group_basic.direct_recipients_helper: One per line or separated by commas. Direct input recipients will receive all levels (Info/Warning/Critical) of notifications.
